source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"These particular concerns being relevant mainly for clients who already have a documented history of prior dialysis-related complications over time","B":"Post-dialysis assessment being treated as an optional step that is left up to individual staff availability and personal preference at the time of the session","C":"Fairly few specific concerns actually existing for a client during the period immediately following their scheduled dialysis treatment session","D":"Clients potentially being at risk for hypotension related to fluid removal during treatment, with the access site needing assessment for bleeding or complications afterward"}}
source_row.rationale: Post-dialysis care includes monitoring for hypotension related to the fluid removal that occurred during treatment, along with assessing the access site for bleeding or other complications, important safety monitoring for every client following each dialysis session.
source_row.source_name: National Kidney Foundation — Post-Dialysis Care Guidelines
